title: Justiciar's Greatshield
summary: Shield granting +2 AC, advantage on Perception, and a Bonus Action cloud of Darkness.

fields.Shield: +2 AC while held. Requires Shield proficiency.
fields.Darkness Cloak: Bonus Action once per Short Rest. Create a 7 ft radius cloud of magical Darkness around yourself for 2 turns, and immediately attempt to Hide. Creatures inside are Blinded and heavily obscured. Ranged attacks cannot pass into or out of the cloud.
fields.Shield Bash: Reaction when a melee attacker hits you. The attacker makes a Strength save against your spell save DC or falls Prone for 1 turn. The tooltip incorrectly lists Dexterity.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Lyrthindor in the Gauntlet of Shar.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
